803.speaker: Narrator
803.text: He violently tore off the gold chain that was hanging around his neck.

804.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
804.text: "Wruhec's Guardians were built on a foundation of lies. We must disband."

805.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
805.text: "It has been an honor serving you, Your Majesty. Despite everything."

807.speaker: Player_Romus
807.text: "You still have the Wruhecist community's respect. I need you to make sure they weather this scandal."

810.speaker: Player_Romus
810.text: "With Sal gone, Rizia is in the market for a new Grand Wiseman."

811.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
811.text: "I-- I could never. Not after this."

813.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
813.text: "I will talk to them. But I cannot promise they'll listen."

814.speaker: Narrator
814.text: He bowed his head and rushed out.

817.speaker: Player_Romus
817.text: "Nothing less than his duty. My father had to die so that Rizia could be reborn. The Grand Wiseman's actions were entirely justified."

818.speaker: Player_Romus
818.text: "As I said, this is all a misunderstanding. The Grand Wiseman is to be released immediately."

819.speaker: Player_Romus
819.text: "My father asked him to assist in the conduction of a sacred ritual. The fact that the ritual took his life is no fault of Sal's."
